name: Gmina Zduńska Wola (Poland)
description: Vertical tricolour of orange, blue and orange, the blue charged with three yellow bees above a white horseshoe with a cross, the charge from the gmina arms.
history: The gmina flag was established by resolution No. 59/2001 of the gmina council of 20 June 2001; Polish Wikipedia describes the version in force since 24 June 2021 as a plain blue field with the charge from the arms.

features.role: three bees from the gmina arms
horseshoe with a cross below the bees
